pricing.trialBadge: 7-day free trial on all paid plans
pricing.title: Choose Your Plan
pricing.subtitle: Build full-stack apps with AI. Every plan includes our multi-agent pipeline. Credits are consumed per build phase (Planner, Coder, Reviewer).
pricing.freeDesc: For hobbyists exploring AI app building
pricing.starterDesc: Entry paid tier for individual creators
pricing.buySubtitle: Extra credits are $1 each. They add to your balance immediately after payment and unpause paused builds.
pricing.howIntro: Each build runs through a 3-phase AI pipeline. Credits are consumed per phase:
pricing.howFooter: A typical full build uses 6 credits (2 + 3 + 1). If you run out mid-build, your project pauses and you can top up credits or upgrade your plan. Unused credits roll over for 30 days.
pricing.creditsNote: Builds reserve {buildCost} credits each when they start. Senior Dev sessions cost {seniorCost} credits. Enterprise is sales-led — contact us below (no self-serve checkout).
pricing.checkoutNoUrl: Checkout did not return a payment URL.

credits.title: Out of credits — work paused
credits.body: You have {credits} credits; this action needs {cost} to {action}. Builds stay paused until you subscribe or buy extra credits.
